paragraph: The Granville composite delivers a solid, bullish-tilted reading of 63/100 with no breadth divergence warning active, confirming that the broader market structure remains favorable for upside follow-through. Internal momentum is distinctly risk-on, propelled by powerful bellwether strength in semiconductors (SOXX/SPY jumping +2.62%) and aggressive risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV up +1.53%), which easily overshadows minor drag from economic transports (IYT/SPY off -0.48%) and neutral broader breadth (RSP/SPY at -0.39%). This posture is reinforced by a benign macro backdrop characterized by a calm VIX at 15.31, a softening US dollar, falling 10-year real yields at 2.42%, and stable high-yield credit spreads tightly anchored at 2.68%. Lean moderately long for the session, expecting high-beta and technology leadership to drive early gains within a low-volatility environment.
